We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: The defendant (金某) sold medical equipment to a public hospital, obtained contracts via bribery (giving kickbacks to hospital director). This is bribery (受贿) but the defendant is the one giving bribes to a state employee. In Chinese law, giving bribes is 行贿 (bribery). The list includes "受贿" (receiving bribes) and "行贿" (giving bribes). The defendant gave bribes, so crime is 行贿 (bribery). Also possibly "贪污"? No, that's embezzlement of public funds. Not applicable. Also "非法占有"? Not. "诈骗"? Not. "非法吸收公众存款"? No. "走私"? No. So likely "行贿". Also maybe "受贿" for the hospital director, but we only label for defendant. The list includes "行贿". So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: The act of selling medical equipment with bribery may also be "经济犯" (economic crime) but not a specific label. The list includes "经济犯". In earlier example, they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That case combined specific crime and "经济犯". Here the specific crime is "行贿". Could also be "受贿" for the director but not for defendant. So answer: 行贿.
